topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The reduced antenna efficiency (41%) impacts link budget calculations by requiring increased transmitter power to maintain signal quality, which can lead to higher complexity in signal processing algorithms due to increased signal strength requirements. This complexity might result in increased computational resources and energy consumption on the receiver side, potentially impacting the overall system performance and efficiency. The physical mechanism involves more signal array factor and potential inter-element interference, affecting overall system capacity and performance.
